item.title: Pitt CC students eligible for new ECU Health loan scholarships
item.description: PITT COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- ECU Health has launched an Academic Loan Scholarship Program to support health sciences students at Pitt Community College. The program offers $5,000 in financial assistance to eligible students from nearly a dozen health sciences curricula, in exchange for a one-year full-time work commitment at ECU Health after graduation. item.title: Pitt County Animal Services hosts half price adoption special
item.description: PITT COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- Pitt County Animal Services is offering a community-sponsored adoption special for all dogs and cats over one year of age, reducing adoption fees to half price until each animal is adopted. The shelter is currently at capacity, caring for 86 dogs and 34 cats, with additional animals expected to arrive. [...]
